name: pos-m2-replay-driver
title: POS campaign M2: replay campaign driver + append-only proof-or-stop ledger (run-batch.mjs, H1/H4 evidence)
description: Third milestone of the proof-or-stop replay and tamper campaign (plan: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md; M0 DONE=B-9e44 froze protocol.json, M1 DONE=B-bae9 built the tamper arm). M2 delivers experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs + a selfcheck: the REPLAY arm. For each scale in {small, full}, it runs N independent generate+verify cycles (N frozen in protocol.json: small=30, full=3) into fresh mkdtemp-isolated directories, and appends one proof-or-stop record per iteration to an append-only identity-keyed batch-ledger.jsonl. Each iteration ends in EXACTLY one record: a proof record {iterationId, arm, scale, verifyStatus, verifyFlags, digests{records,gold,manifest}, goldMetrics, elapsedMs, endOfRunRss, env, recordDigest} or a stop record {iterationId, stopReason (budget_cap|verify_crash|precondition_failed|operator_abort), rawError?, env, recordDigest}. recordDigest = sha256 of the record canonical JSON with recordDigest absent. The driver takes a lockfile (a concurrent second driver records precondition_failed) and exits nonzero if any iteration ends recordless. H1 evidence = pairwise digest+metric equality across replay proof records per scale; H4 evidence = every iteration within the frozen budget cap or an explicit budget_cap stop. Reuses M0 lib/instrument.mjs + reads the frozen protocol.json. Instrument read/called only.
